summary: The marketing team is in execution mode on two fronts: launching the Intelligent China webpage this week and advancing the Knowledge website redesign, while finalizing search/AI visibility groundwork for Asia Star and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: The most urgent item is the Intelligent China webpage launch, which must go live this week as part of the June 30 decision to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China for search/AI visibility. The Knowledge website redesign is moving forward with a hybrid design approach—keeping the current base but incorporating editorial-style elements—and requires Joseph to share the HTML concept and the team to hold a feedback session before Joker implements changes. Behind the scenes, the team is building target audience profiles and auditing Google Ads conversion tracking to support the visibility push, with Joseph drafting the areas/prompts to target. Meanwhile, routine IT issues (Outlook lockout) have been resolved, and upcoming items include finalizing the English obituary for Professor Jon Liao and updating award status in a press release.

decisions.text: Use the locally hosted tool to summarize the meeting
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic across the site.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu) at the top.
Bring the BCI banner into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not add a stock-market-style ticker at the very top of the homepage.
Use the current Knowledge design as the base, taking selected inspiration from Joseph's editorial-style layout to display more articles.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; US partner programs on hold initially.
If adding a third priority, choose the Berkeley program (English-only, joint recruitment) and consider it in the audit phase.
Focus initial search/AI visibility work on China-based programs given stronger demand.
Use English name only (Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business) on the potential award, consistent with last year's approach
